nom: COSRX PDRN Exosome Skinplaning Glaze Mask with Collagen & Peptide

avis.texte: Easy-peasy fun application. And viola! My skin's rough areas were smoother and my entire face was deeply moisturized.
Leaves my skin looking so glowy! Improves skin texture and makes you look so hydrated!
So far used once and left it on for a couple of hours and my skin was glowing, smooth and hydrated!!! Using again tonight! 10/10 recommend!
I always buy 2 because I never want to run out I simply love it.

avis.titre: I keep on buying this product over and over.
avis.texte: I love item, it leaves my face nice and glowing. Recommend it.
Feels great going on, dries like a silky mask and your skin looks refreshed after peeling off.

avis.titre: Glowy radiant skin from this little bottle
avis.texte: I love this product! I use a gentle scrub before applying. My skin looks so glowy and beatiful. It makes my makeup go on better too. This is one I will always have on hand.

Saw an ad for this on another social media site. Most of my skin regimine is using Cosrx. The first time I used it was at night and when I peeled the mask off my skin was absolutley glowing. I have since been using it every morning and now it has eliminated the need for using foundation, green tinted concealer for my rosacea on my cheeks and corrective powder. It covers my imperfections and my skin had a very bright glowing look to it. I'm very pleased with this product.
Tightened and brightened in a way I can usually only achieve with a pro facial. Helped clear an unusual breakout and made me look less tired. Love it!
I absolutely love this mask but when u bought it in store it did not come with a brush?

avis.titre: sticky mess, hard to peel off
avis.texte: I had such high hopes for this, I love CosRX. It has a thick slimy gel texture. hard to apply, you need to use a lot of product. takes at least 30 mins to dry Then the product doesnt peel off in sheets like other peel off masks i am used to. i had to roll it off in small motions, took a while. Still had patches of it stuck on, so then I rinsed the residue off. that is a LOT OF WORK. and my skin felt a little tight, not moisturized at all. Back it goes
I've only used this once and if you're like me and like to peel sunburned skin (gross?) you'll like this! It's satisfying to peel off. My skin did feel very soft after! I will keep using

avis.titre: Husband says my skin looks radiant!
avis.texte: Lightweight, effective, and nice to have the application tool included.

This product merits a five-star rating and a 100% endorsement. If you have not yet experienced this mask, you are overlooking a significant benefit. It delivers immediate results, unequivocally. The included applicator is an added advantage, and the peel-off function performs precisely as expected. This particular Cosrx product is now among the essential items I will consistently incorporate into my regimen.

I applied this mask earlier today and as I was taking it off I noticed my face immediately broke into hives , It did do its job of leaving skin Glowing but I cant see myself using this Peel off ever again, Its been 4 hours and Im still breaking out in Hives all over my face.

I received a sample from Cosrx and Ive never been happier with this mask, it feels great and light weight, Leaves your skin feeling smooth and Glowing beautifully. I have sensitive skin and didnt break me out or anything! Did i Mention this mask has a Pretty Shimmery color😍 It also comes with a Silicone Brush for Easy Sanitary application!

The COSRX PDRN EXOSOME Skinplaning Glaze Mask left my skin unbelievably smooth, glassy, and refreshed after just one use. It gave that post-facial glow without irritation, and my skin looked plumper, brighter, and more even almost immediately. This feels like professional-level results at home.
Easy application, instant improvement in texture and smoothness. A must have reset for a tired gritty face!

I loved this mask! The silicone brush didn't really work for me, so I just used my fingertips to apply it. I left it on overnight, and every morning when I peeled it off, my skin felt so much smoother. I also love how it helps heal and take care of blemishes. Definitely planning to buy it again!

The CosRX PDRN EXOSOME Skinplaning Glaze Mask has very quickly become my absolute favorite CosRX product. It goes on kind of like a white lotion, and then turns in this beautiful iridescent shade. When you on your skin after drying and feels like a silky powder. And when you peal it off, you skin feels absolutely amazing and looks even better. I'm on my second tube. Highly recommend it! Definitely a 10/10
I love this product. You can feel the different after. It's just soft, hydrate, firm.

I have tried this for a few weeks now and I love how soft my skin feels afterward. It has a smoothing effect and my skin has a bounciness to it. The silicone spatula is a nice inclusion in the box, and makes it easier and cleaner to apply across your cheeks and forehead. After waiting for it to dry, it is easy to peel off. Great new product!
Great product. I got better results when I leave it for an hour.

I have aging, combo skin that is also annoyingly sensitive, and I have to say that this was just what it needed! After using, my skin had more moisture and looked plumper and refreshed. It was very easy to use and I appreciated the little tool they provide to minimize contamination. Highly recommend!

This mask is the GOAT! The texture of the cream is very nice and it brushes on super smoothly. I didn't have to use a ton for it to create a thick enough layer to peel off. I left it on over night and it peeled off the great ease the next morning. The effect of the mask on my skin was that it felt so hydrated and supple yet taut! My 18 yo daughter also tried it out with me, and she has very sensitive skin and this is one of the first masks that didn't make her face feel like it was burning!!
I put it on my face and leave overnight and it's amazing! My skin feels so soft and tight/lifted in the morning. I love the tool that comes with it. Very useful and convenient to apply, no mess.

Other than sheet masks I don't use masks in my skincare routine really ever but when this one came out I really wanted to try it especially with winter. I wasn't sure what to expect or if I would really even see results. The first time I tried it I left it on for about 1. 5 hours and it made my skin feel really soft and waited to see if it caused any breakouts which it didn't. The second time I left it on overnight and I'm not sure if the length of time made a huge difference but my face definitely feels softer and smoother.

I haven't used a peel-off mask since I was a teenager, so this was a nostalgic experience for me. The silicone applicator brush is very useful and seems more hygienic than using fingers. My skin definitely feels smoother after two short applications. I really want to try to keep it on longer to see greater benefits, but I can't use it overnight since I have mischievous kittens who like to nibble on my nose while I'm sleeping. While I usually don't like skincare products with strong fragrances, this product would feel more like a relaxing spa experience if a little scent was added. Besides that, I'm happy with the initial results and look forward to seeing additional improvements after each application.

I received the COSRX PDRN EXOSOME Skinplaning Glaze Mask for a free trial. I've used the product only three times. But since the first use, I surprisingly saw a difference. I have sensitive, combination skin and this did not irritate, clog my pores, or have any other diverse effects. I used it as an over night mask and peeled it off in the morning.

The glow you get after using it is really noticable. I've tried using overnight, but I think I just leaving it on for an hour or so it works just fine. It peels off nicely when it's dried without sticking very much.

I tried the PDRN mask and it was interesting. It goes on well with the silicone brush. I really liked the brush applicator. It helps to smooth the product over the skin. I did apply it a bit on the thicker side, so I gave it extra time to dry. Peeling was rather easy once I got the edge on my forehead. The glow of my skin was amazing. I loved it. There was no essence left on my skin so I used the snail mucin essence and the glow remained. I can't wait to try it again. I definitely recommend this mask.

I have combination skin, with mostly dry skin outside of my T-Zone, and I've always struggled to find something to properly hydrate my skin for a long time, especially during winters. I'm not going to lie, I was a bit skeptical of this product (& novelty ingredients in general), and now even sure what the benefits were for, but the first try left me pretty impressed. I only needed to do one layer of moisturizer after using this instead of the typical three. I'm on week three of using this, and I'm pretty satisfied. I think it might become a regular in my skincare routine.
I leave it on my face all night, stated two weeks ago and my face feels perfect in the morning, its a great product
Made skin look very smooth. As it dried, made my skin a little tight. Overall good results.

Very nice on my skin, with no irritation. I like the application tool a lot, I don't like to touch things to my fingers if I can help it. I only tried it once so far but the immediate results seemed good for a nice fresh face.

The mask feels nice and my skin glows afterward. I had some trouble applying it evenly to my face—the mask didn't spread easily over my skin—but that may well be a user error. Ultimately, a lovely product. My skin is happy and I'm happy for her.
I love the way my face looks after using pdrn Super easy to apply with provide applicater And has a great texture
It's a great product!!! I love this product. It makes your skin radiant and glowy. The silicone applicator is really useful. Will definitely incorporate in my skincare routine.

This mask provides an interesting skincare experience. It goes on smoothly (the brush is helpful in applying it) and feels refreshing on the skin. It then dries down and becomes rubber-like (in a comfortable way). When it has fully dried, you peel it off your face and are left with hydrated and supple skin. If you lean towards the drier side, I would suggest to seal in the moisture with a heavier face cream or a face oil. I found the mask to be a comfortable and fun experience. My skin is very sensitive and there was no irritation or discomfort. I would definitely recommend the mask.
I absolutely LOVE this product! Easy to apply and leaves my skin so soft. The result is fewer noticeable lines and wrinkles. This texture of the mask has a relaxing effect as it dries.

I have never used a peel off mask from this brand before and I am really enjoying this one! It came with a little spatula type applicator. I was filled with surprise the first time I used it as it has a bit of a cooling effect. Once it dries, you peel it off and your skin looks amazing! All the dead skin gone and your skin is glowing.

I haven't tried a mask from this brand before, but I love this one! It makes my skin feel so smooth and glowing. I use the goodnight peeling gel all the time and I have loved having this addition to my routine.

I applied the PDRN mask and did a few housecleaning chores. After 15 minutes, I peeled it and was genuinely impressed with how supple my skin was. Application is easy with the silicone tool. The applicator makes it quite easy to apply evenly. I've used it twice and each time, my skin feels soft and hydrated. It's wonderful!

avis.titre: I would buy a gallon of this if I could
avis.texte: I am 39 years old. I have combination skin that leans to the oily side. I tried to smash for the first time the other night. I left it on for an hour and peeled it off. Because I can't sleep with things on my face. That night, my skin had a light Dewey glow to it, which was beautiful. I went ahead with my normal hyaluronic acid, cosrx moisturizer. In the morning, I rinse my face off before the gym and the whole day. It still had this beautiful Dewey glow and the texture was so smooth. My skin is pretty smooth anyway with a bump here or there. But I am in love with this mask as I have been in love with all of cosrx products for a long time now I will absolutely be a frequent buyer of this if I could buy a gallon of it, I would. I don't have problematic skin, but this made it look so beautiful and I needed it way less make up.
Best product ever, I really recommend it. . . Right after applying my skin is glowing and my pores shrink

Love this product. I typically have sensitive skin that prohibits peeling masks, but this mask did not irritate my skin. The silicone applicator made application so easy. My skin was glowing and felt so hydrated after removal. Definitely recommend
Incredible product. Leaves skin feeling clean, fresh and smooth.
This is an awesome product. Skin feels wonderful after using. Would recommend to all.
This is wonderful. apply at night. remarkable results. it make pores less visible and shiny skin

This was interesting! I have never tried a mask like this. I love the silicon brush and how it makes the mask easy to apply. The mask went on smoothly and evenly. (I had fun freaking out the husband and my pets when I had the mask on lol). My skin definitely felt smoother after the first use. I'm looking forward to incorporating this into my skin care regimen. Thank you for a great product!

Application was easy as the product was simple to manage and the silicone brush was flexible enough to accommodate different areas of the face. It dried evenly and could easily come off as one piece. Could definitely tell that my skin had a glow and looked and felt smoother after application and removal. Very nice 😄

avis.titre: Not bad. Could use some tweaks.
avis.texte: I like it but I wish it had gone on a bit thicker. It felt papery and wasn't all that easy to peel off. That being said, I felt it helped strip away some of the buildup oil that accumulates on my skin. It wasn't harsh - it didn't sting upon application & it wasn't too drying.
I loved how smooth my skin felt after first use. I look forward to seeing what my face will look like in a few weeks
The effect of this mask on my skin is remarkable. It looks like I had a spa facial. Will definitely be trying it again soon!

My skin already loves COSRX products but this one has out done all the others! The product is a little thicker than I expected, it seemed very similar to Elmer's glue in texture but nothing unappealing. The product spreader that came with the product was perfect for application. I used overnight and woke up with it still intact and easy to peel off. It left my skin was absolutely radiant! My skin looked like I had a filer on it. I'm looking forward to testing out any new COSRX PDRN products they might have coming :)

This is my new favorite Face Mask! I wear the mask for about an hour and when I peel it off, my skin looks fresh, hydrated, and has a healthy glow to it. I'm very pleased with this product and will definitely get it again in the future!

I've used this product three times and I can say you will feel a difference on your skin. It woke up with a glow and skin that looks and feels refreshed. The brush is also small and so easy to use and store. My only con about this product was that it smells like Elmer's glue. . either way I still love it and will continue to use! Makeup looked so good too! Bug pro, Shipping is always so quick with COSRX, I got it in 3 days.

I tried the COSRX PDRN EXOSOME Skinplaning Glaze Mask to see if it would help me with my combination skin (oily and some dry patches). It was really easy to do and peeled off quickly. After using it, my skin felt supple and hydrated. I've used it a couple more times since, and my skin feels smoother. I'm going to keep using it.

I luckily got the chance to try the PDRN Exosome Skinplaning Glaze Mask, and it was a genuinely nice experience for a type of product that I usually wouldn't use. The texture is lightweight but still feels nourishing, and the formula spreads easily and coats without any sticky residue leftover. After using it, my skin looked noticeably smoother, especially when I left on for overnight. The PDRN and exosome blend really seems to help with hydration and overall skin resilience. My complexion looked calmer and balanced by the next morning. One of my main skin issue is uneven texture, this mask gave an immediate "glazed" finish and a refreshing feeling without irritation. The packet contains a generous amount of product, enough to comfortably cover the entire face and neck. There's no heavy fragrance, and it didn't cause breakouts or redness. Overall, this is a mask was a pleasant surprise. I'm not really a big fan of peel off due to the discomfort of removing but this delivers visible results, feels soothing, and gives that hydrated, glass-skin glow with no discomfort from pinching and pulling to remove it.
I have combination skin (on the drier side) and this mask leaves my skin really hydrated, soft, and bright. I use a thickish layer so it's take 15 minutes to dry but it works so well!!

I can't really say how effective this mask is long term because I've only had it long enough to use a couple times. I will say the mask itself is very nice and easy to apply and peel off. It leaves my skin looking straight up perfect for the rest of the day, but don't really notice much immediate lasting effects yet, but again haven't had it long enough to see. I'd say the snail mucin mask has a longer lasting immediate effect.

I have been using this for a few weeks now and I have honestly seen an improvement in my skin texture. First of all, the packaging is beautiful, and i love that it comes with a spatula for application. It spreads beautifully on my skin and it looks like im applying liquid pearls on my face. At night , I use my toner, serum and moisturizer, let them absorb, then apply the glaze mask last, making sure it is completely dry before I go to sleep. In the morning, i peel it off and my skin is literally glowing underneath! I also noticed that the texture on my face that i was a bit concerned about has improved significantly! I have used other nighttime masks and they did not work for me, so i thought these type of masks were a gimmick, but this skinplaning glaze mask has definitely changed my mind. Will certainly recommend purchasing!!!

I just love the results…only after 1 hour, my skin feels supple yet firmer somehow! The pores on and around my nose appears to be smaller. The mask peeled off gently too! I've trusted COSRX for at least 5 years…and this is definitely a keeper! Thank you 🙏

This product leaves skin smooth, plump, and clear after use! Seemed to help with minor acne breakout as well, Did not cause any skin irritation from use. Product comes with a nice application brush. The product liquid looks white with tiny sparkles. Skins feels a little tight during application, but not uncomfortable. You can peel the mask off after 15-20 minutes, or wash it off.

Very thick mask where using the included silicone brush is a must for an even application. There is a tightness sensation as the mask dries and the mask is definitely accomplishing what it is meant to. Left on overnight and awoke to a lovely fairy glow. This mask is a perfect addition to COSRX's regiment. I did not experience any allergic reaction, however, I've been an avid BHA/AHA COSRX user for over 3 years. I do experience a tingling sensation with the AHA BHA PHA LHA 35 Peel, no tingles with this one. . . just a lovely tightness with a kick of glow!
Using this mask left my skin feeling freshed and hydrated. I look forward to using this product regularly.

I just used this absolutely wonderful product for the first time. After one use, my skin is not only glowing, but it looks younger!!! At 66 with sun damage, I'll take that! This will most likely be another one of my forever products!

I have only ever used clay masks that need to be washed off, so this was a new experience. The brush made spreading the mask quite easy. The only downsides I noticed: - The mask made my skin feel a little tight as it was drying. - The mask was a bit challenging/messy to remove (I had trouble getting off all the bits on the perimeter). However, the results are undeniable. My skin looked radiant immediately after I took off the mask. Much brighter and glow-y than before. I would recommend this product. Learning to take it off more efficiently will probably come with more use.
This amazing product is soo good. It makes my skin feels nice, soft and moist. This will be on my list to buy for sure

I have not used a facial mask that peels off in so long and I was expecting dry, dehydrated skin once removing the mask, but my skin had a nice glow to it, and I think it has reduced some of the texture I have on my chin. I have only used a few times over the past 2 weeks, and it has not irritated, or caused any breakouts to my face, so I will continue to use as it seems like a solid product

This is such a game changer! The peel experience is so nice different from any other peel off mask I have had. It comes off with ease, but you can also feel it working, and is not messy. I love the way my skin feels after removing it. Been using it a couple weeks and my skin approves. Thank you COSRX 😍
The skinplaning Glaze mask is awesome. My skin is revived, supple and smooth with a nice glaze appearance. It's like I just came from a professional facial after using.
I'm loving this mask it really goes deep inside your skin covering all your needs. The best mask ever 100% recommended

This is my honest opinion and experience with PDRN EXOSOME Skinplaning Glaze Mask. I have used it two times. The first time, I didn't see anything difference on my skin. The second time, I noticed that after applying my makeup my skin looked smoother. My skin is healthy most of the time, so I imagine this product will help someone with a bit of rough skin.
The texture is thicker than expected, but not in a bad way. The brush was not bad. It got the job done. It was a little hard to spread it in crevices. It was easy to peel off if spread evenly.
I bought and used the COSRX PDRB EXOSOME Skinplaning Glaze Mask, and my face felt and looked great.

I wanted to try this a few times before posting a review. I have dry sensitive middle-aged skin, and I can confidently say this left my skin feeling soft and supple immediately after peeling off the mask. Also noticed that my follow-up skin care products (mostly COSRX brand such as the ceramide moisturizer) went on more smoothly and my skin had a nice glow and bounce. Two thumbs up! Thank you, COSRX, for this awesome product! Btw, this comes with a silicone spatula for application which worked nicely so I didn't have to use my fingers.

I've always been skeptical of products that claim results after one use. 9 times out of 10, it doesn't. But I was completely left in shock after my first use of CosRX PDRN EXOSOME! Not only did it delivered what it claims, but it left my skin feeling AMAZING! It starts off kind white in color and kinda sticky, but once it dries it turns into this beautiful iridescent color that is silky to the touch. My pores were almost invisible. This will now be my go to product to keep my skin looking its best. I highly recommend it! See results after the 1st use for yourself.

Although product is a cream, it dries like gel. First time user, thank you for the sample. The application is easy and glides on very well, drying time was on point and film peeled off easily. During and after pictures attached, so far love the after effect which is matting (I do have oily skin), yet skin looks and feel moisturized. Will share more finding with additional use.
this product goes on so smoothly it feels amazing on My face results glowing skin😍

This mask was easy to apply, especially with the brush. I put it on right after showering and left it on for about an hour or so. It was very smooth, and peeled off easily. I could definitely tell that my skin was softer and more ""plump"" with less visible pores.

I kept it on for about an hour and my skin looked exactly the way they claimed it would. I did a light mist of the ceramide skin barrier moisturizing mist before applying it. I planned on wearing it over night but I think it needs to be put on right before bed for that because it started to lift off around my mouth and nose from talking and snacking. If it looks this good after an hour I really want to see what it looks like wearing it all night. Also, I didn't get anything for this review, I didn't get a free product to try or anything like that… I just thought it looked like a good mask and bought it. CosRX has yet to let me down
